essence: The deity is characterized as both materially beneficent and protective toward devotees.
A practitioner under these restraints must never eat śrāddha food or cucumber.
A practitioner under these restraints must never touch husks or cotton seeds.
The mantra succeeds for one who is endowed with the prescribed restraints.
The previous mantra is a formula of twenty-six syllables.
